name: adversarial-v1
description: Synthetic adversarial invariants executed against the real PostgreSQL Data Platform path.

metadata.purpose: collection/tenant isolation, duplicate handling, conflicting evidence preservation and stale-source last-known-evidence behavior

cases.description: Searching one collection must never return a matching document from a different collection.
A protected collection must fail closed for an unauthorized consumer and remain searchable for an authorized consumer.
Federated retrieval must emit one winner when the same canonical URI exists in multiple collections.
Distinct sources with contradictory values must both survive retrieval so downstream contradiction checks have evidence to inspect.
Repeated refresh failures mark a URL resource stale without deleting its last-known indexed evidence.
